4.label: Exceeds Standard
4.description: Fluently adds and subtracts within 100 with regrouping; constructs and explains rectangular arrays.

3.label: Meets Standard
3.description: Consistently solves two-digit addition and subtraction problems using place value strategies.

2.label: Approaching Standard
2.description: Solves without regrouping; makes errors when carrying or borrowing across place values.
2.action: Targeted base-ten blocks and visual regrouping practice

1.label: Below Standard
1.description: Struggles with two-digit operations; requires single-digit foundation reinforcement.

standards.description: Fluently add and subtract within 100 using strategies based on place value and properties of operations.

levels.4: Solves two-digit addition/subtraction mentally with speed and precision.

standards.description: Use addition to find the total number of objects arranged in rectangular arrays with up to 5 rows and up to 5 columns.

levels.4: Writes repeated addition equations and connects directly to multiplication.
levels.3: Correctly determines array totals and writes repeated addition.
levels.2: Counts array elements individually with occasional errors.
levels.1: Cannot interpret array rows and columns.
